description: Bluesky profile analytics: followers, following, posts, bio, engagement rate (likes, replies and reposts), avg likes/replies/reposts, posting cadence, recent posts and follower history. Use to get public numbers for a Bluesky account (handle like name.bsky.social, a custom domain handle, a did:plc or a bsky.app URL). Returns name, bio, followers, following, posts, metrics {engagementRate, avgLikes, avgComments, postsPerWeek, daysSinceLastPost, tier}, recentPosts[] with likes, replies, reposts and quotes, bluesky {did, avgReposts, createdAt}, history[] and growth30d. Fresh within 6 hours by default. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails. Includes free daily calls, no wallet needed.

handle.description: Bluesky handle (with or without @), e.g. jay.bsky.team or alice (= alice.bsky.social), a custom domain handle, a did:plc or a bsky.app profile URL
